description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml, so one bot owns dependency updates here.
Scoped to cargo and github-actions. Scala/sbt dependencies are Scala Steward's
(.github/workflows/scala-steward.yml) and Renovate is kept off them, so the two
do not propose the same bump twice. The old Dependabot config said the same:
it covered 'the ecosystems Scala Steward does not'.
Renovate does understand sbt. If Steward is ever retired, drop the
enabledManagers line and Renovate will pick up the sbt build.
PIN, carried over verbatim from .github/dependabot.yml's `ignore` list.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain is NOT an ordinary action bump: its @rev selects the
Rust compiler, which is pinned in rust-toolchain.toml as well, and
scripts/check-rust-toolchain-pin.py fails the build when the two disagree.
No bot can satisfy that -- it does not know the .toml has to move in the
same commit -- so a bump here is red by construction.
It has happened twice. #164 proposed 1.99.0 -> 1.120.0, which is not even a
Rust release: the install failed outright and the drift check rejected it.
#169 was the same bump again, and was closed. Because the actions group is
`*`, one unsatisfiable bump reddens the whole weekly PR and blocks every
unrelated action in it -- which is why this is an ignore and not a cap.
The toolchain moves deliberately instead: edit rust-toolchain.toml and both
ci.yml refs together, then re-run clippy locally, because a new stable
routinely enables new lints.

packageRules.description: Was the github-actions 'github-actions' group (patterns: *), weekly. dtolnay/rust-toolchain is excluded by the rule above.
Was the cargo ecosystem on /oblivious-sidecar, group 'cargo' (patterns: *), weekly.
